hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Australian practical shooting association IPSC Australia Inc Regional Director Gareth Graham [ 1 ] Parent organization International Practical Shooting Confederation Website ipsc .org .au IPSC Australia Inc is the Australian association for practical shooting under the International Practical Shooting Confederation . It consists of seven sections: Victoria and Tasmania , South Australia , New South Wales , Australian Capital Territory , Queensland , Northern Territory and Western Australia .
